source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 26 April 1924, p. 5 ("Magherafelt Rural Council")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the Mid-Ulster Mail nomination list of 26 April 1924; the Gulladuff votes read in the Irish News of 3 June 1924

note: Nomination-day report for the twenty-six electoral divisions of Magherafelt rural district, one member each. Twenty-five candidates were returned unopposed; James Henderson withdrew from Tobermore, leaving John Colhoun returned. Gulladuff alone was contested, on 30 May 1924. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
